mode_options.label: Off
mode_options.description: Asks before changes and commands that Droid's rules do not already allow.

mode_options.label: Low
mode_options.description: File edits and low-risk commands can run without asking.

mode_options.label: Medium
mode_options.description: Reversible development actions can run without asking. Droid can still ask for approval.

mode_options.label: High
mode_options.description: High-risk actions can run without asking, subject to Droid's safety rules. This is not unsafe permission bypass.

mode_options.label: Spec
mode_options.description: Plans first and waits for your approval before implementation.
